title: AI-Powered Recruitment Automation Platform
summary: A Generative AI-based recruitment solution for resume parsing, structured candidate profile extraction, and semantic candidate-job matching.
overview: A recruitment automation platform that parses resumes into structured candidate profiles, matches candidates to job requirements semantically, and exposes backend APIs for resume storage, retrieval and candidate suitability analysis.
problem: Recruiters review many resumes in free-form layouts. Turning them into structured profiles and judging relevance to a job requires more than keyword matching.
approach: Built a Generative AI-based recruitment solution for resume parsing and structured candidate profile extraction.
Implemented semantic candidate-job matching to evaluate the relevance of candidate profiles against job requirements.
Designed backend APIs for resume storage, retrieval, and candidate suitability analysis.
Used vector search and LLM-based processing to support candidate discovery and recruitment workflow automation.

architecture.label: Resume parsing
architecture.detail: Generative AI extracts a structured candidate profile from a resume.

architecture.label: Semantic matching
architecture.detail: Candidate profiles are compared with job requirements by semantic relevance.

architecture.label: Backend APIs
architecture.detail: APIs handle resume storage, retrieval and candidate suitability analysis.

architecture.label: Technologies
architecture.detail: Python, FastAPI, OpenAI API, Pinecone and MongoDB are listed. Which component used which technology is not specified.

workflow.step: A resume is ingested and parsed by an LLM-based process.
A structured candidate profile is extracted and the resume is stored.
Candidate profiles are matched semantically against job requirements.
Vector search and LLM-based processing support candidate discovery and suitability analysis.

items: Built the resume parsing and structured candidate profile extraction.
Designed backend APIs for resume storage, retrieval and candidate suitability analysis.
Used vector search and LLM-based processing for candidate discovery and workflow automation.

limitations: No accuracy scores, hiring outcomes or candidate volumes are available, so none are claimed.
The platform supports analysis and discovery. It is not documented as making autonomous final hiring decisions.
The resume does not attribute this project to a specific employer.
future_improvements: Possible direction: bias and fairness review of matching outputs.
Possible direction: a labelled evaluation set to measure matching relevance.
